label: Mathematical core has no infrastructure dependencies
description: regelsuche-core must not reference Neo4j, Spring, Hibernate, JPA, Testcontainers, Docker or GraalVM.

label: Search kernel is infrastructure-free
description: regelsuche-search must not reference Neo4j, Hibernate, JPA, Testcontainers or GraalVM.

label: Validation kernel is infrastructure-free
description: regelsuche-validation must not reference Neo4j, Hibernate, JPA, Testcontainers or GraalVM.

label: Persistence port has no database driver dependencies
description: regelsuche-persistence must not reference Neo4j, Hibernate or JPA drivers directly.

label: Gradle module dependency graph is acyclic
description: The dependency graph across all regelsuche-* Gradle modules must be a directed acyclic graph with no cycles.

label: Cross-module communication is port-driven (Teil-0 interfaces first)
description: All public cross-module APIs must be declared as Java interfaces (RuleIndex, SearchTraceStore, HypothesisRepository, DiscoveryExperimentRunner, …).

label: Discovery runs are reproducible
description: Experiment and discovery runs must produce deterministic, reproducible outputs captured in replay artefacts.

label: Hibernate and JPA are isolated to the persistence-hibernate adapter
description: Only regelsuche-persistence-hibernate is permitted to reference Hibernate or JPA; no other module may do so.
